entities.name: Sor Marcela de San Felix
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Marcela de San Félix (1605–1688) was a Spanish nun who worked as a prelate, a teacher to novices, and housekeeper among several other jobs. However, Sor Marcela was also a poet, an actress as well as a dramatist.
